text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaah, krrssshhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaykes, that's some crazy thunderstorm, 
deesu! Let's get under those street trees 
over there...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? Fuji-senpai? What in the world, 
someone beat me to it...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, taking shelter from the rain too, El?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's just like a tropical squall. It's as 
if a 'thunder spirit' is throwing a wild 
rampage. ...Look, there it goes again!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's true, it won't keep raining 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look, El, take a look.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? It's completely stopped 
raining...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even thunderclouds will eventually be dyed 
in "crimson." After all, they cannot cover 
the sky forever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And once a little more time passes—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Next, the stars will blanket the sky. So 
many stars that you couldn't possibly hold 
them in both hands."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The lead role... is something that shifts 
around just like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't even count all my wins on both 
hands anymore! Trainer, before I knew 
it...
choice_data_list: Yeah, your GⅠ win count is over 10 now.
Yeah, your GⅠ wins have passed ten now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly an extraordinary feat among 
feats. To think an Umamusume would appear 
who could claim 11 or more Dirt G1 
victories.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
11... Ah, that reminds me, when I looked 
far into the future with Feng Shui before—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"There was a time when I saw '11 stars.' 
Maybe that was a sign of this..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think it would come true so 
quickly☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her momentum was truly like a shooting 
star. And on the day of the award 
ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Big Thanks!! Thank you 
all for celebrating today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to win so many GⅠs 
is all thanks to everyone's cheering, my 
many friends, and of course, Trainer-san☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, please give my Trainer and 
friends just as much applause as you gave 
me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ricky-chan, you're so sweet. Thinking 
of us too, of all people...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, with everyone looking at us like 
this... I might be feeling more nervous 
than Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always considerate of those around her. 
Indeed, this very mindset— is what led to 
her great record.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. There's just one last person I 
absolutely have to thank, though—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Could you come with me? I wouldn't really 
get a chance to go otherwise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the place Copano Rickey headed to 
was—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Found you, Kita-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Misteeer, hello! It's been so long!

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Ohh... You guys are...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The park where Copano Rickey and Kitasan 
Black used to play together as kids. 
There, they found—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The benefactor who allowed her to race 
freely stood there with a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, mister! It's all thanks to you 
being so kind to us...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I managed to win so, so many times! And 
thanks to that, Kita-chan can run her 
heart out too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to share a little bit of this 
trophy with you, Mister♪ No matter how 
much I thank you, it's never enough☆

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, of course I'm always watching both 
of your successes on TV.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Still, the trophy isn't necessary. I've 
already received more than enough of a 
gift from the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A sufficient gift?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
As long as the two of you run 
energetically like back then and return 
safely from the track, that's more than 
enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
"Just stay healthy and full of energy. 
That's my only wish."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mister...! Yeah, thank you☆

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you happen to be Rickey's 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Please look after Rickey-chan from now on 
as well. She's an Umamusume I've watched 
over as if she were my own child.
choice_data_list: Yes, I'll bring them along again.
Yes, I'll bring them along again.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Wait, "again"...?
choice_data_list:
This park is practically like a hometown 
to the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Hometown... My hometown, you say?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! It's the precious, 
precious place where I first learned to 
run☆ That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See you again, mister! Now that we've done 
this, Kita-chan and I will definitely be 
back♪

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, you're welcome anytime. 
Everyone's waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps in the distant future, a time will 
come when Copano Rickey spends her days by 
this park once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, now is not yet the time. I will 
rack up far more victories and return.
